verdict.rationale: Simular's own site claims that a taught workflow "reruns on a schedule" (simular-docs-17). Supporting docs show workflows can be saved as parameterized, replayable code skills (simular-docs-7, simular-docs-9) that keep running after the laptop is closed (simular-docs-18). However, scheduling itself rests on a single marketing line, with no documentation of how schedules are defined, managed, or triggered via the API. Missing for 10: documented schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, UI or API endpoints), management of recurring runs (listing, pausing, editing), first-party technical docs on scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
